description: Book an option from international_quote. Requires the option_id the user chose (before its valid_until), full pickup and delivery addresses with company, contact name, phone in international format and email, a pickup window, and the items exactly as quoted (omit items when the quote used containers or volume). For door_to_port and port_to_door options, set port_charges_acknowledged only after the user has accepted that charges at the far port are extra. Customs: collect what you can in customs (hazmat confirmation, commodity lines with Schedule B / HTS / HS code, value, country of origin, tax ids, EEI choice for US exports); anything missing can be added later with international_customs, and the forwarder follows up for it. The incoterm and direction are set from the route. An international booking cannot be cancelled through the API (cancellations go to Warp support), so only call after the user explicitly confirms this option and price. Payment follows the account (terms, balance or card); if a payment_link comes back, the order is held until the user pays there. Auth required.

customs.description: Customs data. Send what the user has; the rest can follow with international_customs.

commodities.description: One line per kind of goods. A line with description, code, country of origin, value, quantity and weight is complete; anything missing is collected by the forwarder after booking.

country_of_origin.description: Where the goods were made, ISO alpha-2

eccn.description: US exports: ECCN; leave empty for EAR99 goods

hs_code.description: No US end (between two other countries): 6-10 digit HS code

license_type.description: US exports: license type or exception, e.g. NLR

value_usd.description: Total value of this line, USD

weight_lbs.description: Total weight of this line, lb

consignee_tax_id.description: Consignee tax id in its country's format

ear99_no_license.description: US exports: every item is EAR99 and needs no export license

eei_authorization.description: US exports: the shipper authorizes the forwarder to file the EEI in AES. Needed when any one Schedule B line is over $2,500 or a license is required, unless an ITN is given.

exporter_of_record.description: Only when someone other than the shipper is the exporter of record

tax_id.description: Tax id in the party's country format (US: EIN)

zipcode.description: Required where the country uses postal codes

importer_of_record.description: Only when someone other than the consignee is the importer of record (e.g. the seller or a broker clears import)

tax_id.description: Tax id in the party's country format (US: EIN)

zipcode.description: Required where the country uses postal codes

importer_of_record_number.description: US imports: the consignee's importer of record number (EIN or CBP number YYDDPP-NNNNN)

importer_registration_number.description: Destination importer registration: Brazil CNPJ (14 digits) or CPF (11), Colombia NIT, Argentina CUIT (11 digits), Nigeria Form M (MF + 8-12 digits)

isf.description: Ocean imports into the US only: Importer Security Filing (10+2) parties. The forwarder files it with the customer after booking; country of origin and HTS come from commodities.

itn.description: US exports: the ITN, when the shipper files the EEI itself

no_hazmat.description: The shipper confirms nothing is hazardous: no batteries (also inside devices), aerosols, perfume or paint. Ask the user; without it the forwarder asks before moving the freight.

shipper_tax_id.description: Shipper tax id. US exports: the EIN (9 digits); if omitted, the EIN on the account's customs profile is used.

country.description: ISO alpha-2 country code; must match the quote

instructions.description: Dock, access or appointment notes for the driver

phone.description: Contact phone with country code, e.g. +862150000000

ref_nums.description: References for this stop (PO, SO, the customer's billing reference)

state.description: 2-letter state / province code in the US and Canada; region or province name elsewhere

window.description: Time window as ISO 8601 UTC timestamps. Pickup: when the freight is ready. Delivery: indicative only for international.

zipcode.description: Postal code. Required in the US, Canada and countries that use one; must match the quote

international_info.description: Advanced: raw fields in gw's internationalInfo shape, merged over customs

items.description: The items exactly as quoted. Omit when the quote used containers or volume.

quantity.description: Number of identical pallets / pieces in this line

stackable.description: Whether units can be stacked. Defaults to false.

option_id.description: option_id the user chose, from your MOST RECENT international_quote

country.description: ISO alpha-2 country code; must match the quote

instructions.description: Dock, access or appointment notes for the driver

phone.description: Contact phone with country code, e.g. +862150000000

ref_nums.description: References for this stop (PO, SO, the customer's billing reference)

state.description: 2-letter state / province code in the US and Canada; region or province name elsewhere

window.description: Time window as ISO 8601 UTC timestamps. Pickup: when the freight is ready. Delivery: indicative only for international.

zipcode.description: Postal code. Required in the US, Canada and countries that use one; must match the quote

port_charges_acknowledged.description: true once the user accepts far-port charges (door_to_port / port_to_door only)
